Paragraph: "Seeing these birds united with their mates makes my heart ache with the sorrow of separation, Lakshmana..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Witnessing pairs of birds swimming together amplifies Rama's feelings of loneliness.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama confides his heartache to Lakshmana upon seeing animal companionship.
Outcome/Resolution: He shares his pain, seeking relief through honest communication.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Viraha-DuHkha (The specific suffering born from forced separation from one's life partner)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Illustrates how seeing companionship in nature deepens the soul's yearning for its missing half.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Relational loneliness triggered by observing bond-affirming behavior in others.
